reviewer: parent assistant source-consistency spot review; not clinician adjudication
coverage: Full note and label read for first ten remaining interleaved cases; observations are not exhaustive.
validation: All quoted source spans and provided label excerpts/section paths checked exactly.

observations.source_quote: En route to the ED via ambulance, the patient was noted to have a pulse in the thirties and a systolic blood pressure of 50 mmHg.
observations.explanation: Arrival vital signs do not retain these earlier severe measurements. Medication-context coverage also needs review; current label only names nifedipine.

observations.source_quote: One gram of hydrocortisone IV was infused and 20 mg prednisone was prescribed per day for 5 days.
observations.explanation: Prednisone frequency and five-day duration are absent. Chronic sinvastatin treatment is also absent; preserve source spelling rather than medical correction.

observations.source_quote: The differential of this mass included a left vagal schwannoma or a lymph node in proximity to the vagus nerve.
observations.explanation: MRI differential is absent; preserve differential status. Bipolar disorder is also absent from broad history; serial MRI advice and declined surgery require coverage review.

observations.label_excerpt: Right multicystic dysplastic kidney in the fetus with no other abnormality
observations.source_quote: The anatomy scan however showed a right multicystic dysplastic kidney in the fetus with no other abnormality ().
observations.explanation: The subagent claimed this was absent, but the full label retains it verbatim. Reject the omission flag. Source-qualified suspected MODY-5 is a separate possible coverage omission.

observations.source_quote: Physical examination revealed splenomegaly, although the patient was asymptomatic.
observations.explanation: Splenomegaly is retained in examination and symptoms; do not count its absence from the imaging result alone. Six-month asymptomatic follow-up is a separate possible omission.

observations.source_quote: At his 2 month follow up, his MRI showed significant improvement in previously resected and previously radiated intracranial masses and no new intracranial masses.
observations.explanation: Later imaging confirms previously radiated lesions, so earlier nonreceipt does not prove third-craniotomy radiation was never performed. Omission of earlier nonreceipt/nonadherence and death is a separate issue.

observations.label_excerpt: well-defined mass in the left parapharyngeal space
observations.source_quote: Radiologic features were consistent with glomus vagale.
observations.explanation: Qualified radiologic impression is missing; do not upgrade to definitive tissue diagnosis.

observations.label_excerpt: No pain radiating to arms or legs
observations.source_quote: The pain arose each night 2 h after she went to sleep, and it was described as unbearable.
observations.explanation: Early nightly timing and severity are absent. Later mainly-at-night wording does not fully preserve the earlier pattern.
Ibuprofen frequency is absent. Prior conservative weight-loss course and situs inversus also warrant coverage review; do not infer completed sleeve surgery beyond cutoff.

observations.label_excerpt: Planned but not completed due to acute presentation
observations.source_quote: plans were made to proceed with laparoscopic cystgastrostomy.
observations.explanation: Whole-label treatment entry explicitly preserves noncompletion; surgery array does not list cystgastrostomy. Reject the invented surgery-path allegation.
